options.name: clone_app_view
options.description: Enabling this option will clone app view.

options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: control_file
options.description: Yet to be implemented.

options.name: diag_path
options.description: Yet to be implemented.

options.name: fra_path
options.description: Fra Path.  Yet to be implemented.

options.name: fra_size_mb
options.description: Specifies the Fra size Mb.

options.name: log_time
options.description: Log Time. Yet to be implemented.

options.name: no_recovery
options.description: No recovery. Yet to be implemented.

options.name: oracle_base
options.description: Specifies the oracle base directory.

options.name: oracle_data
options.description: Oracle Data. Yet to be implemented.

options.name: oracle_home
options.description: Specifies the Oracle home directory path.

options.name: overwrite
options.description: Enabling this option will overwrite the database, if already available.

options.name: redo_log_path
options.description: Redo Log Path. Yet to be implemented.

options.name: source_db
options.description: Specifies the name of the database which needs to be recovered.

options.name: source_server
options.description: Specifies the source server name where database is located.

options.name: source_type
options.description: Specifies the type of Oracle deployment of the source database. Use C(standalone) for a single-node Oracle host. Use C(rac) for Oracle RAC where the source_server is the SCAN address or cluster VIP.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines if the oracle recovery should be C(present) or C(absent). absent is currently not implemented.

options.name: target_db
options.description: Specifies the name of the target database that will be restored. If the database is not already available new database will be created.

options.name: target_server
options.description: Specifies the oracle server where database is restored.

options.name: task_name
options.description: Specifies the restore task name

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.
